title: Credit Builder Accounts Late and Returned-Payment Fee Terms
content:
## Terms in force

1. A late fee on a Credit Builder account may be assessed only when the current date is later than the payment due date plus the late-fee grace period. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the payment due date.
2. A missed payment is reported to the credit bureaus once it is the plan's reporting threshold of days past due (30 days on every Credit Builder Accounts plan).

The payment due date the grace period runs from is the due date the account record shows as its next due date, which is its oldest unpaid due date. The late-fee grace period is 15 calendar days on every plan, and the comparison is strict: a date equal to the due date plus the grace period is not later than it.

## Grace period boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Payment due date | Last day of the grace period | Date of a proposed late fee | May a late fee be assessed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May | 25 May | 25 May | no, the date is not later than the due date plus the grace period |
| 10 May | 25 May | 26 May | yes, if the payment is still unpaid |
| 31 January | 15 February | 16 February | yes, if the payment is still unpaid |

## Retired clauses

> The late fee is the plan's late-fee percent of the monthly payment, rounded to the cent and not more than the plan's late-fee maximum, at most the plan's maximum number of late fees per due date, and only on an account in active status.

> A returned-payment fee of the plan's returned-payment fee is charged once per returned payment whose return code is one of the plan's fee-bearing return codes, never for R07, R10, R29 or a chargeback.

Both clauses are no longer in force as written: each has been superseded by the current Credit Builder basis for that fee, which governs every late fee and every returned-payment fee charged on a Credit Builder account.

superseded_clauses: The late fee is late_fee_percent of the monthly payment, rounded to the cent and not more than late_fee_max_usd, at most max_late_fees_per_due_date per due date, and only on an account in active status.
A returned-payment fee of returned_payment_fee_usd is charged once per returned payment whose return code is in fee_bearing_return_codes, never for R07, R10, R29 or a chargeback.
